laws.rule: In Cerro Castillo National Park, CONAF says heat sources and fire are only allowed in places set up for them by the park administration. In March 2026 it reported visitors detected using fire at Campamento Río Turbio who had to leave the park and were cited.

CONAF says introducing polluting substances into water bodies inside protected wild areas is prohibited; washing cookware with detergent in Laguna Cerro Castillo led to infractions in February 2026. No fine amount is stated on the page.

sources.title: Cursan infracciones por incumplimiento de normativa en el Parque Nacional Cerro Castillo (4 March 2026)
